_comment: CANONICAL list of merged+accepted Schema Change Requests. fethi-web appends an SCR id here in the SAME PR that merges the SCR's migration + regenerated types, then copies this file (and database.types.ts) into fethi-mobile/src/shared/types/. The mobile coordination gate (scripts/check-scr.mjs) reads the vendored copy to block consumer tasks whose SCR hasn't shipped. See docs/db/COORDINATION.md.
